name: Geometry Screening
description: Repeatable geometric screening of a saved snapshot: room area against a brief table, door width against a minimum, a turning circle inside a room outline, and travel distance through doors to exit rooms. Every finding names element ids, the measured value, the threshold and the unit. A screening aid, not a code compliance check. Read-only.
author: AEC Model Bridge

snapshot_id.description: Saved snapshot to screen. Take it with snapshot_take first (include rooms for door room keys).

snapshot_units.description: Length unit of the snapshot coordinates and widths. Revit stores feet. Thresholds and results are always in metres.

room_area.description: Room area against a brief. Rooms are matched by exact room number or room name (not case sensitive).

door_width.description: Door width against a minimum. Reads the Clear Width parameter, else Width, on the door, else on its type.

turning_circle.description: A circle of the given diameter must fit inside each listed room outline.

rooms.description: Room numbers or names to check.

travel_distance.description: Shortest path from each room centroid through door points to the nearest exit room, over rooms joined by doors (From Room and To Room).

exit_rooms.description: Room numbers or names that count as exits.

from_rooms.description: Limit the start rooms. Default is every other room with an outline.

max_items.description: Maximum findings listed per check; counts are always complete.
